project: Sounding v2 — the fleet. Blend probe on natural rows, four-cell design
authorises: fleet expansion of prereg_v17's pilot, on the design brief the pilot earned
committed_before_analysis: TRUE — sealed before any fleet instance is generated. The pilot's 13 rows are re-run under the corrected scoring; no new row has a rate at sealing time.

why_this_expansion_is_different.statement: for the first time in this programme's history the blocker is SAMPLE DESIGN, not population existence.
why_this_expansion_is_different.terroir_c: died because the rows did not exist — 0 admissible families under every reading.
why_this_expansion_is_different.sounding_S2: was INSUFFICIENT because nine scored rows confounded region-kind with hardness. Decision-easy optimisation rows EXIST IN ABUNDANCE — the atlas's tractable canon. This wall is made of recruitment, not mathematics.

1_four_cell_occupancy.rule: the region-kind x hardness design must have ALL FOUR CELLS occupied: {solutions, optimal} x {decision-easy, decision-hard}.
1_four_cell_occupancy.the_pilot_gap: easy x optimal was EMPTY (0 rows). All 5 optimal-region rows were decision-hard and all 4 decision-easy rows were solutions-region, so region kind and hardness were not separable and no amount of n would have separated them.
1_four_cell_occupancy.generator_census_done_before_sealing: MST enumerates 297 spanning trees at n=7 in <0.01s; matching 66 at n=6 in 0.01s; s-t paths need a denser generator than the census probe used; max-flow at unit capacity shares the edge-vector encoding. LINEAR-PROGRAMMING and GAUSSIAN-ELIMINATION are CONTINUOUS regions and ship `n.a.-encoding` per design law 2.

2_region_size.PRIMARY: ENSEMBLE TUNING. Per-row instance parameters are tuned so region sizes land in a declared target band, killing the confound at source rather than adjusting for it after.
2_region_size.SECONDARY: explicit r-stratification, reported as the CHECK THAT THE TUNING WORKED — the residual corr(log r, rate) and the gap within each r stratum. If the strata still disagree, the tuning failed and the statistic is not scored.
2_region_size.why_tuning_is_primary: with ~17 rows, modelling r from 17 points is weak. Removing the confound beats estimating it.

3_forced_flavours_excluded_BY_SCHEMA.rule: S-2's statistic is computed over NON-FORCED flavours only, enforced in the emitting code, not by remembering at scoring time.
3_forced_flavours_excluded_BY_SCHEMA.why: in the pilot, 42% of the apparent separation was S-1's theorem-forced zeros bleeding into S-2's mean — every decision-easy row is a CSP carrying exactly one forced zero that dragged it down.
3_forced_flavours_excluded_BY_SCHEMA.the_law_this_generalises: THE NETTING LAW AT FLAVOUR LEVEL. Theorem-forced credit has been netted inside a statistic (defect #15), inside an instrument's type signature (grid Flag 1), inside a study design (instance 21), and now inside a PER-FLAVOUR MEAN. Same error, four scales. A forced flavour is excluded from any discovery statistic by construction.

the_design_brief_as_sealed_law.4_S3_inherited_sealed: the within-family cut, Terroir vocabulary verbatim (FAMILY-BORNE / GEOMETRY-RESIDUAL / MIXED / INSUFFICIENT), sealed from birth as in v17.
the_design_brief_as_sealed_law.5_S4_registry: probe-feature predictions filed before any literature contact. Standing.

F1_calibration.claim: every theorem-forced pairing returns EXACTLY 0.0, on the fleet including the four new rows
F1_calibration.on_failure: HALT — instrument, encoder or enumerator bug
F1_calibration.credit: NONE beyond implementation correctness. Forced by the polymorphism definition.

F2_mechanism_four_cell.claim: with all four cells occupied and forced flavours excluded by schema, decision-hard rows show higher violation rates than decision-easy rows WITHIN region kind
F2_mechanism_four_cell.direction_sealed: harder rows louder, tested WITHIN each region kind separately and never pooled across them

F3_within_family.claim: F2's separation, if any, evaluated inside families against within-family nulls
F3_within_family.expected: INSUFFICIENT on most families; declared, never argued past

F4_registry.claim: predictions filed before literature contact for any open cell in scope

kill_criteria.four_cell_floor: if the design does not actually fill — any cell with zero rows after the generator census — THE CENSUS IS THE FINDING and F2 is not scored. No forcing.
kill_criteria.tuning_floor: if ensemble tuning cannot bring region sizes into the target band, say so and score nothing that depends on comparability.
kill_criteria.box: 2-4 h paired, $0 compute. Stated BEFORE starting, per the ruling. The four generators are ~30 lines each and enumerate sub-second; the cost is the scoring rework, not the recruitment.

boundary_held.statement: this authorises the fleet DESIGN and its run. It does not touch the write-up.
boundary_held.W_review: remains open independently. The paper waits on the owner's read, not on this run, and neither blocks the other.
